messages:
margo: Heads-up: were lining up a cross-cloud marketplace push next month including partner H100 images, H200 fallback lanes, B200 burst SKU, MI300 pilot, and Gaudi SI onboarding. Need a concise owner map and any hard blockers called out now.

henry: Ill take H100 pipeline. Current hard blocker: partners kernel module fails our notarization and also triggers a cgroup throttling alert at sustained 600-token streams. Filed PART-3201. Asking partner to supply a signed module or a no-module build.

david: MI300 pilot update (quick): model bundle delivered but IP attestation & export review pending. Legal said SI-limited pilot ok with signed attestation; otherwise MI300 stays behind a feature flag. ETA for attestation: 2025-02-12.

sophia: Ops note: Gaudi SI handoff requires mounted NFS docs + VPN cert refresh. Our tunnel cert expires in 72h; scheduling renew. Also B200 burst validated in lab but autoscaler mis-schedule seen under short spikes (ENG-8019).

margo: Owners: Henry=H100 notarization & fallback; David=MI300 attestation & flag; Sophia=Gaudi runbook + cert; I'll coordinate marketplace comms and embargo. Proposed soft date for SI-only listing: 2025-02-20, GA target 2025-03-06. Any immediate red flags?

henry: If partner cant deliver signed module within 48h, fallback plan: ship image with kernel module disabled + doc note and mark H100 as "accel-limited". Also requesting vendor escalation to their firmware team now.

david: For MI300 deterministic eval please use this canonical run command and attach logs to PART-3220:
```
./bench --model mi300-quant --seq 2048 --batch 2 --seed 42 --repeat 4 > mi300-eval.log
# upload mi300-eval.log to Jira PART-3220
```

sophia: VPN cert renew scheduled: 2025-02-11 01:00-01:30 UTC. Will post maintenance note. I'll also run NFS dry-mount on gaudi-int on Tue and tag SI contacts. ENG-8019 linked and I'm capturing scheduler traces.

ops-bot: Staging publish queued for `marketplace/partner-batch-feb-2025` 1) blockers: PART-3201 (H100 module), PART-3220 (MI300 attestation), ENG-8019 (autoscale) 1) timestamp 2025-02-10T12:00:00Z

margo: Quick comms constraints: marketing requires a 10-business-day embargo notice plus partner legal sign-off. Please surface any schedule slip as soon as you see it so we can adjust the embargo. Reconvene Thu 10am PT for status. :white_check_mark:
